provenance.timezonePolicy: Resolve NY weekday/session/date with America/New_York DST. CME termination uses Europe/London; UK/US DST transitions differ.
provenance.overlapPolicy: Retain all overlapping tags; do not turn federal banking holiday into equity closure; no implicit multiplier product.
provenance.economicMeaning: Scheduled category is a testable market-regime hypothesis, not evidence of BTC correlation, profitability, or threshold adequacy.
